angle: Rather than presenting Bayes' rule as a fixed plug-in formula, this video reframes testing as updating prior odds by a single Bayes factor and derives the odds form so one precomputed factor can be reused across priors and sequential evidence.
angle_detail: Begin with [00:00]–[02:09] for the thousand-woman counting paradox that fixes sensitivity, specificity, and predictive value, then study [11:01]–[13:07] for the odds-form derivation and reuse logic. Remember the video substitutes disease prevalence for the prior and flags that symptoms or contacts would change it, so do not carry prevalence over blindly. It is dense at twenty-one minutes and its Bayes-factor material belongs to conditional-probability nodes, so treat the L01 fit as base-rate intuition only.
